name: Herb book: pregnancy and nursing notes from journal articles
description: Some pregnancy and nursing cautions (calendula, fennel, hibiscus, lavender, licorice, nettle, raspberry leaf, sage, thyme, yarrow) are written from open-access journal articles under Creative Commons Attribution licenses: Grigoriu C, Varlas V, Călinescu G, et al., "Phytotherapy in obstetrics: therapeutic indications, limits, and dangers", Journal of Medicine and Life, 2021 (PMC8811673, CC BY 3.0); Almajid A, Bazroon A, AlAhmed A, Bakhurji O, "Exploring the Health Benefits and Therapeutic Potential of Roselle (Hibiscus sabdariffa) in Human Studies: A Comprehensive Review", Cureus, 2023 (PMC10676230, CC BY 3.0); Bowman RL, Taylor J, Davis DL, "Raspberry leaf (Rubus idaeus) use in pregnancy: a prospective observational study", BMC Complementary Medicine and Therapies, 2024 (PMC11034164, CC BY 4.0); Tobanche Mireles Y, Zamora-Pérez AL, Galván Valencia M, et al., "Genomic and Cytotoxic Damage in Wistar Rats and Their Newborns After Transplacental Exposure to Hibiscus sabdariffa Hydroalcoholic Extract", International Journal of Molecular Sciences, 2025 (PMC12347892, CC BY 4.0). Each herb's page names its articles, their authors and licenses among its sources. The wording in this app is adapted, not quoted.
